purpose: Teach: 従兄弟/見分け/嫌っ/よくなる/こらえ/探さ/さして/ペンキ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、従兄弟、絶対、お店に来てくれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your cousin actually came to the shop — I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, warm opening. Aoi's name lands with affection. Quick pace, eager to share good news. Genuine delight in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの、本気で、絶対、見分け、絶対、お客様、絶対、難しいみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items seem to be tricky for customers to tell apart.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly worried undertone. Gentle observation rather than complaint. Slow enough to show she's thinking it through. Seeking understanding, not blame.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、嫌っ、絶対、てたお客様、絶対、また来てくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But that customer who used to avoid us? They came back again.
lines.style: Lift of pleasure on 'came back.' Bright confidence. This is proof of something — let it land. Quick, almost triumphant.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の売上、本気で、絶対、よくなる、絶対、と、絶対、嬉しいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm so glad the sales are picking up, you know?
lines.style: Warm, genuine relief. The 'you know' is conversational, checking in. Soft pace. Pride in Aoi's work, not flashy — real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お忙しい時も、本気で、絶対、こらえ、絶対、て、絶対、頑張ってね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Keep doing your best even when it gets busy, okay?
lines.style: Tender encouragement. Not a command — a wish. Soft attack, slight breathiness. Trailing gently, like she's tucking the words in carefully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新しい食材、絶対、探さ、絶対、なきゃ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're going to need to keep hunting for new ingredients.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact tone. This is a gentle truth. Measured pace. Not discouraging — just clear-eyed about what comes next.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、さして、絶対、宣伝してないのに、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you're already popular without even really advertising — that's amazing.
lines.style: Wonder and admiration underneath. Slight emphasis on 'already.' Pace picks up with the realization. Genuine astonishment at what she's built.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の壁、本気で、絶対、ペンキ、絶対、塗り直したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You repainted the shop walls too — I saw it.
lines.style: Observant delight. She notices details. Warm appreciation for the care Aoi puts in. Quick, intimate tone — this matters to Mei that Aoi is tending to her space.
